---
title: "mzML Conversion"
description: "Convert vendor raw files (.wiff, .raw, .d) to open mzML with ProteoWizard MSConvert — the input INTEGRATOR expects"
editor_options:
  markdown:
    wrap: 72
---

INTEGRATOR reads MS data in the open **mzML** format. MSConvert, part of
the ProteoWizard suite, converts vendor raw files — SCIEX `.wiff`, Waters
`.raw` folders, Thermo Fisher `.raw` files, Agilent `.d` folders — to
mzML. Conversion runs on Windows only.

1.  Install or upgrade to a **recent** version of
    [ProteoWizard](https://proteowizard.sourceforge.io) on a Windows
    computer. A recent version ensures support for current vendor
    formats.

2.  Launch **MSConvertGUI** from the Start menu, or by right-clicking the
    raw files and selecting *MSConvertGUI*.

3.  Click **Browse** to select the raw files to convert. For SCIEX data,
    keep the `.wiff` and `.wiff.scan` files together in the same folder.

4.  Set the options: *Output format* → **mzML**, *Binary encoding
    precision* → **32-bit**, and enable **Write index**. To speed up
    large batches, raise *Files to convert in parallel* to the number of
    available CPU cores.

5.  Click **Start**, then copy the resulting mzML files into the `mzML`
    subfolder of your MRMhub project.

![](images/paste-13.png){fig-align="center" fig-alt="Screenshot of the MSConvertGUI window configured to output mzML. In the Options panel, Output format is set to mzML with 32-bit binary encoding, and Write index and Use zlib compression are enabled; the Start button at the bottom right runs the conversion."}
